description: A Moroccan team with humble skills
summary: We developed Monochrome Landscapes by researching scientific resources from organizations such as NASA and USGS, alongside other planetary research references. We collected and organized information about Earth's extreme environments and their similarities to Mars and the Moon. Then, we built an interactive website to present this information through dedicated explorers and a structured database. Our goal was to make planetary analogue research easier to discover, understand, and explore.
details: Monochrome Landscapes is an Earth–Mars–Moon analogue research platform that explores how Earth's extreme environments can help us understand other planetary worlds. It brings together information about terrestrial analogue sites, planetary environmental conditions, and scientific references in one accessible platform. Through its Earth, Mars, and Moon explorers, users can discover relevant environments, examine available data, and explore similarities and differences between planetary settings. The platform also emphasizes scientific transparency by identifying data sources, estimates, models, and information requiring further verification. Its main objective is to make planetary analogue research more organized, understandable, and accessible while supporting scientific curiosity and future exploration.
